name: Lingkaran Trans Kota Holdings Bhd
summary: Lingkaran Trans Kota Holdings Berhad (LITRAK) is an investment holding company that engages in the design, construction, operation, management, and maintenance of the Lebuhraya Damansara-Puchong and Western Kuala Lumpur Traffic Dispersal Scheme (SPRINT) toll highways in Malaysia. Incorporated in 1995, based in Subang Jaya, Malaysia.
